calculated.label: Calculated
calculated.about: Mathematically derived from the measured pulse signal.

estimated.label: Estimated
estimated.about: Derived by an algorithm from the pulse signal.

experimental.label: Experimental
experimental.about: Not sufficiently validated. Treat as a rough camera estimate.

measured.label: Measured
measured.about: Obtained directly from the camera pulse signal.

research.label: Research
research.about: Research model that needs your own calibration against a validated device. Not a measurement.

disclaimer: Camera measurements are for general wellness. They are not a medical measurement or diagnosis.

guidance.face_multiple: Make sure only one face is in view.
guidance.face_none: Position your face inside the oval.
guidance.light_bright: The light is too bright. Avoid direct sunlight on your face.
guidance.no_finger: Cover the rear camera and flash completely with your fingertip.
guidance.pressure: Press more lightly. Your fingertip is pressing too hard.

reasons.duration_short: The recording was too short for this value.
reasons.experimental_off: Experimental estimates are turned off in Settings.
reasons.face_not_supported: Face scans can't estimate this value.
reasons.few_beats: Not enough clean pulse beats were detected.
reasons.needs_calibration: Needs your own calibration against a validated device first.
reasons.no_face: A single face was not detected for long enough.
reasons.no_finger: The fingertip did not cover the camera for long enough.
reasons.outside_calibration: The signal is outside the range you calibrated.
reasons.pressure: The fingertip pressed too hard, so the camera was overexposed.
reasons.research_off: Research estimates are turned off in Settings.
reasons.resp_disagree: The breathing signals did not agree.
reasons.short_history: Needs at least 5 earlier scans of the same type.

sources.chrom: de Haan G, Jeanne V. Robust pulse rate from chrominance-based rPPG. IEEE Trans Biomed Eng 2013;60:2878-2886.
sources.elgendi: Elgendi M et al. Systolic peak detection in acceleration photoplethysmograms measured from emergency responders in tropical conditions. PLoS One 2013;8:e76585.
sources.hrv: Task Force of the ESC and NASPE. Heart rate variability: standards of measurement. Circulation 1996;93:1043-1065; Shaffer F, Ginsberg JP. Front Public Health 2017;5:258 (ultra-short-term HRV).
sources.ica: Poh MZ, McDuff DJ, Picard RW. Non-contact, automated cardiac pulse measurements using video imaging and blind source separation. Opt Express 2010;18:10762-10774.
sources.lomb: Lomb NR 1976; Scargle JD 1982; Clifford GD, Tarassenko L. Quantifying errors in spectral estimates of HRV due to beat replacement and resampling. IEEE Trans Biomed Eng 2005;52:630-638.
sources.pca: Lewandowska M et al. Measuring pulse rate with a webcam: a non-contact method for evaluating cardiac activity. FedCSIS 2011:405-410.
sources.pos: Wang W, den Brinker AC, Stuijk S, de Haan G. Algorithmic principles of remote PPG. IEEE Trans Biomed Eng 2017;64:1479-1491.
sources.resp: Karlen W et al. Multiparameter respiratory rate estimation from the photoplethysmogram. IEEE Trans Biomed Eng 2013;60:1946-1953 (RIIV/RIAV/RIFV smart fusion).
sources.spo2: Ratio-of-ratios pulse oximetry principle; smartphone camera feasibility: Scully CG et al. IEEE Trans Biomed Eng 2012;59:303-306. Camera SpO2 is not clinically validated.
sources.sqi: Elgendi M. Optimal signal quality index for photoplethysmogram signals. Bioengineering 2016;3:21; Orphanidou C et al. IEEE J Biomed Health Inform 2015;19:832-838 (template matching).
